title: Posterior concentration in spatio-temporal Hawkes processes
summary: We develop a Bayesian nonparametric framework for inference in spatio-temporal Hawkes processes, extending existing theoretical results beyond the purely temporal setting. Our framework encompasses modelling both the background and triggering components of the Hawkes process through Gaussian Processes priors.
